key.name: devices-config
key.description: JSON object keyed by device id: {sku, alias, placement (hidden|panel|quick-settings), order}.

key.name: presets
key.description: JSON array of presets: [{id, name, steps: [{deviceId, power?, brightness?, temperature?, color?, scene?}]}].

key.name: use-lan
key.summary: Control lights over the local network
key.description: Send commands over the Govee LAN API when a light is reachable, and use the cloud only as a fallback.

key.name: refresh-stale-seconds
key.description: Light state fetched from the cloud is refreshed when a menu opens and the last refresh is older than this.

key.name: cache-stamp
key.description: Bumped by the preferences window after it rewrites the device cache, so the shell reloads it.

key.name: lan-scan-request
key.description: Bumped by the preferences window to ask the shell for a LAN scan; the shell writes results to ~/.cache/govee-lights/lan.json.

key.name: request-counter
key.description: Used to warn before the Govee daily limit of 10,000 requests is reached.
